lems even with this explanation, as according to Darwin and to Joseph Priestley, what the sun raised from

xxxiii). The fauns’ science in fact seems deliberately old-fashioned; Humphrey Davy had proved by 1817

souls which measure in their circumscribed domain the distances of yon orbs, are we but the bubbles
